summary.text: Emily Chenevert is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 66, representing East Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2023 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Emily Chenevert's occupation as Media/Communications Consultant.
It lists Emily Chenevert's education as Leesville High School; B.A., Journalism, Manship School of Communications; New York Film Academy.
The House member page lists Emily Chenevert's committee assignments as Administration of Criminal Justice; Civil Law and Procedure; Judiciary; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
